About Us

A Premier Lodge in the Heart of Plateau State

Binchak Country Lodge is a proud member of the Binchak Group of Companies, nestled in the scenic Kankur Village, Bwarat District, Langtang LGA — surrounded by the breathtaking hills and rock formations of Plateau State.

We offer a complete hospitality experience — from luxuriously furnished rooms and a vibrant restaurant and bar, to a fully equipped conference hall and a magnificent event center capable of hosting up to 1,000 guests.

Whether you are visiting for business, leisure, or a special occasion, Binchak Country Lodge guarantees comfort, warmth, and unforgettable memories.

Premium Quality 24/7 Security Constant Power Free Parking
